To give students structured, engaging practice beyond the classroom while giving teachers practical tools to organise learning, assign work and monitor participation
, thereby improving the academic and innovative standard of the school.

Quiks is a learning and practice platform built for different stages of education: Quiks Children for younger learners, Quiks Teens for secondary-school and college-age students, and Quiks Uni for tertiary learners.

Quiks is also designed to suit personal use, for example, a student using it to study and learn personally and for Institutional use, for example, a school using it to aid and enhance learning and performance.
For a school partnership, the appropriate variant can be recommended by age group so that content, language and challenge level remain relevant.

The platform complements teaching rather than replacing it. Students can practise subjects, revise difficult topics, receive explanations and extend learning through the Learning Hub. Teachers can use Classroom tools to organise students, create learning activities
such as tests, assignments, exams and lesson notes

One platform can serve different ages, subjects, grades, curricula and target examinations.
With Quiks Classroom, teachers can generate questions for test, assignment and exams. This solves a big problem for teachers and also increases efficiency and productivity of the teachers.

Teachers can upload their lesson notes and ask the app to refine or enhance it. The students can view and download the soft copy of the lesson notes from the app. This reduces the stress of writing notes and copying on the board again.
Automated marking for tests and exams

Quiks automatically scores and grades student’s activities carried out on the app. This reduces the time and stress the teacher would have deployed in doing this. It also eliminates errors in marking and scoring.
The teachers can use the learning hub to do research and develop their lesson plans, notes and enrich their classes.
Students have a guided route for practice, revision and topic exploration outside lesson time.

With unlimited practice and quiz sessions, learning hub, competition arena and the classroom features, Quiks have more than enough tools to engage the students both in school and at home to improve and better their academic performance.
Quiks generates custom made content for students based on their target exams and curriculum. With this, they can use Quiks to prepare for any exam.
Better continuity between school and home.
Classroom activities and learner profiles help carry assigned learning beyond the physical classroom.
Quiks as a self-learning app is a perfect and cost-effective app parents can use to keep their wards engaged when at home.

Parents or students can set daily study targets while creating their profile. This helps parents to keep track of studying minutes and progress, as the app records performance scores and time spent studying.
